comparison.objective: Hot-swap a battery while preserving uptime and safe pack handling, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual make-before-break extraction/insertion and pack transport versus hex-key use, collar adjustment, torque control, and response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Correct charged pack installed within a 4 s empty-bay limit, with other packs safely located and upright versus two safe carriage stops and a passed witness-torque test.
comparison.reason: The task tests time-critical exchange and handling, not adjustable damping or retained calibration. No spec versions are present; insertion-depth and station-power thresholds are not stated.
